punchline: Schwieger saw a hull, a speed and an angle; everyone aboard stayed outside the periscope.
thirty_sec: On 7 May 1915 U-20 was heading home, low on fuel, when Schwieger fired a single torpedo at the Lusitania. His log notes a second explosion he did not expect; about 1,195 of the 1,959 aboard died.
question: Which decision of yours lands on people you only see as numbers?
key_contrast: The view through the lens, not the full picture.
